hint.en: Optional orientation profile for landscape titles outside the built-in list; place it under coolbaremu/ with this exact name.
hint.zh: 可选的方向配置，用于内置列表之外的横屏游戏；放到 coolbaremu/ 下并保持文件名不变（区分大小写）。

notes.en: Loads .cbe Coolbar applications. Uses a phone keypad: D-pad, Confirm, soft keys and Select for the number layer. Most titles present a 240x400 portrait screen; landscape titles rotate automatically. An optional coolbaremu/coolbaremu_orientation.csv support file covers titles outside the built-in profile.
notes.zh: 加载 .cbe 酷吧应用。操作对应手机键盘：方向键、确认键、左右软键，按住 Select 切换数字层。多数游戏为 240x400 竖屏，横屏游戏会自动旋转。可用可选的 coolbaremu/coolbaremu_orientation.csv 支持文件补充内置列表之外的横屏游戏。
